reuse.why: Uses the existing getAccountToUpgrade lookup and the shared pre-link guard that every link path already calls.

duplication.why: The rule is written once; no copy per provider.

placement.why: The check runs in the shared pre-link guard before any write or sync, but assertBankAccountNotLinked's name now understates that it also rejects closed accounts.

scope.why: Only the guard and a test.

maintainability.why: Small and central; a rename or separate assertAccountLinkable helper would make the guard's purpose clearer.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Reuses getAccountToUpgrade and the existing guard called by linkGoCardlessAccount and linkProviderAccount.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by both linkGoCardlessAccount and linkProviderAccount before saveLinkedAccount.
